mapper.select: SELECT s.SALES_ID, s.SALE_DATE, s.PRODUCT_ID, s.QUANTITY, s.AMOUNT, LOWER(u.INPUT_TYPE) AS SOURCE FROM SALES s JOIN SALES_UPLOAD u ON u.UPLOAD_ID = s.UPLOAD_ID WHERE u.STORE_ID = #{storeId} ORDER BY s.SALE_DATE, s.SALES_ID
SELECT MAX(UPLOAD_ID) FROM SALES_UPLOAD WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_SALES_UPLOAD.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO SALES_UPLOAD (UPLOAD_ID, STORE_ID, INPUT_TYPE, FILE_NAME, RECORD_COUNT, DATA_FROM, DATA_TO, UPLOADED_AT) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{storeId}, #{inputType}, #{fileName}, #{recordCount}, #{dataFrom}, #{dataTo}, #{uploadedAt})

SELECT SEQ_SALES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO SALES (SALES_ID, UPLOAD_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, AMOUNT) VALUES (#{s.salesId}, #{uploadId}, #{s.productId}, #{s.saleDate}, #{s.quantity}, #{s.amount})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SALES WHERE UPLOAD_ID IN (SELECT UPLOAD_ID FROM SALES_UPLOAD WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId})
